The timed count loop invokes the GPU helper on its GPU branch; on its CPU branch it enters GOMP_parallel and the worker handles the local row range. source_evidence.claim: CSR row arithmetic; timed runtime-count branch chooses GPU helper or CPU OpenMP computation for the rank-local rows; result flow.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed loop counter and branch call GPU helper or GOMP worker; GPU helper configures/launches the kernel and copies the result, while outlined worker traverses assigned rows and each complete CSR interval with arithmetic/store and scheduling backedges.

Exact selected SM86 kernel bounds row index against row count, handles short rows, unrolled 4/16/8-entry chunks with loop backedges, handles remaining entries, and stores the row result at SASS line 675.
